title: Cribbage
tagline: Count fifteens, pairs and runs; first to 121.
teaser: The card-and-pegboard classic: build the crib, peg as you play, and count every hand on the way to 121.

manPage.synopsis: cribbage — discard to the crib, play for points, count your hand.
manPage.description: Earl T. Cohen wrote the game logic and Ken Arnold the screen interface for BSD’s cribbage.

howToPlay: Keep four cards and put two in the crib.
Take turns playing cards, scoring as the count builds.
Count your hand and peg your way to 121.
